SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as sample_mdl_dte,
    o.uid,
    o.pmt_hnd_cnt_rat_3m,
    o.pmt_hnd_cnt_rat_1m,
    o.pmt_hnd_amt_rat_3m,
    o.pmt_hnd_amt_rat_1m,
    o.pmt_crd_nmb_3m,
    o.pmt_crd_nmb_1m,
    o.pmt_crd_amt_pmonth_his,
    o.pmt_crd_amt_his,
    o.pmt_crd_amt_3m,
    o.pmt_crd_amt_1m,
    o.pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
    o.pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
    o.pmt_blc_not_eng_3m,
    o.pmt_blc_not_eng_1m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_6m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_3m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_1m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_6m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_3m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_1m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_6m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_3m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_1m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_6m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_3m,
    o.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_1m,
    o.payment_day_6m,
    o.payment_day_3m,
    o.payment_day_1m,
    o.payment_cnt_dis_6m,
    o.payment_cnt_dis_3m,
    o.payment_cnt_dis_1m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_6m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_3m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_1m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_6m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_3m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_1m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_6m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_3m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_day_1m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_6m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_3m,
    o.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_1m,
    o.mid_2_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
    o.mid_2_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
    o.mid_1_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
    o.mid_1_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
    o.mdl_dte,
    o.ds
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.pmt_hnd_cnt_rat_3m,
            f.pmt_hnd_cnt_rat_1m,
            f.pmt_hnd_amt_rat_3m,
            f.pmt_hnd_amt_rat_1m,
            f.pmt_crd_nmb_3m,
            f.pmt_crd_nmb_1m,
            f.pmt_crd_amt_pmonth_his,
            f.pmt_crd_amt_his,
            f.pmt_crd_amt_3m,
            f.pmt_crd_amt_1m,
            f.pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
            f.pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
            f.pmt_blc_not_eng_3m,
            f.pmt_blc_not_eng_1m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_6m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_3m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_dis_rate_1m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_6m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_3m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_rate_1m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_6m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_3m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_day_1m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_6m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_3m,
            f.payment_not_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_1m,
            f.payment_day_6m,
            f.payment_day_3m,
            f.payment_day_1m,
            f.payment_cnt_dis_6m,
            f.payment_cnt_dis_3m,
            f.payment_cnt_dis_1m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_6m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_3m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_dis_rate_1m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_6m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_3m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_rate_1m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_6m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_3m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_day_1m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_6m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_3m,
            f.payment_balancenotenough_cnt_dis_1m,
            f.mid_2_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
            f.mid_2_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
            f.mid_1_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_3m,
            f.mid_1_pmt_blc_not_eng_rat_1m,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.ds,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_12payment_info_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
